careers at vertical insure
Help build the future of embedded insurance.
We’re building the infrastructure that helps software platforms offer protection directly within the products their customers already use. It’s a complex challenge at the intersection of software, fintech, and insurance, and we’re looking for curious, driven people who want to help shape what’s next.
 View Open Roles

Minneapolis Headquarters

High-Growth Startup
Join a team helping define one of the fastest-growing categories in fintech and insurance.
Why Vertical Insure
Work on meaningful problems with people who care deeply about the outcome.
At Vertical Insure, you’ll help software platforms unlock new revenue streams, improve customer experiences, and provide financial protection when it matters most.
We’re a team of builders, operators, and problem-solvers who care about doing exceptional work without unnecessary bureaucracy. We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and support each other through every stage of growth.
our values
How we work.
We Handle Hard Better
We embrace challenges that others avoid. Building a category-defining company requires persistence, resilience, and a willingness to solve difficult problems. 
Win as One Team 
Success isn’t individual. We share knowledge, support one another, and celebrate collective wins. When challenges arise, we face them together.
Think Like Owners
We treat company resources with care and make thoughtful decisions. Being disciplined allows us to invest where it matters most and create long-term value.
Craft Excellence
Quality is intentional. Whether we’re building products, serving partners, writing code, or creating campaigns, we sweat the details and take pride in our work.
